dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-frequency serrated perimeters; shows a sharp gradient transition from low-luminance dark grey exteriors to high-luminance light silver-blue interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity silver-white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily along the mid-dorsal ridge and upper right flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal annuli form a wide obtuse triangle; a series of five high-intensity blobs on the right flank form an irregular elongated polygon.
